title.es: Predicciones: be bound to, be likely to, be about to

objective: Al terminar expresas el futuro con matices: be bound to, be likely to, be about to, be due to, be on the point of y predicciones con seguridad variable.

warmup.prompt_es: 'Seguro que ocurrirá', 'es probable que ocurra', 'está a punto de ocurrir'. El futuro en inglés no es solo will: cada estructura aporta un grado distinto de certeza o de plan.

text: Experts agree that artificial intelligence is bound to change the way we work. Many routine tasks are certain to be automated within the next decade, and some jobs are likely to disappear altogether. However, new professions are also sure to emerge. A recent report predicts that one in three workers will have to learn new skills by 2035.

At this moment, the first fully autonomous bus service in the city is about to be launched. The vehicles are due to start running on 1 September, and the mayor is expected to cut the ribbon at a ceremony next Monday. The company says that the buses are unlikely to cause delays, but passengers are not guaranteed a seat.

On the research side, a team of scientists is on the point of announcing a major discovery. It is hoped that their findings will lead to a new type of battery. If the tests succeed, the battery could be in production by 2030. But, as one researcher put it, 'Nothing is certain until it has been tested. We may well be wrong.'
input.es: Los expertos coinciden en que la inteligencia artificial va a cambiar sin remedio la forma en que trabajamos. Es seguro que muchas tareas rutinarias se automatizarán en la próxima década y es probable que algunos empleos desaparezcan por completo. Sin embargo, también surgirán con seguridad nuevas profesiones. Un informe reciente predice que uno de cada tres trabajadores tendrá que aprender nuevas habilidades para 2035. En este momento, el primer servicio de autobuses totalmente autónomos de la ciudad está a punto de ponerse en marcha. Los vehículos empezarán a circular el 1 de septiembre y se espera que el alcalde corte la cinta en una ceremonia el lunes. La empresa dice que es poco probable que los autobuses causen retrasos, pero no se garantiza asiento a los pasajeros. En el ámbito de la investigación, un equipo de científicos está a punto de anunciar un gran descubrimiento. Se espera que sus hallazgos lleven a un nuevo tipo de batería. Si las pruebas tienen éxito, la batería podría estar en producción en 2030. Pero, como dijo un investigador, 'Nada es seguro hasta que se ha probado. Bien podríamos estar equivocados'.

md_es: **Futuro con matices**
| Estructura | Sentido | Ejemplo |
| **be bound to + verbo** | seguridad casi total (lógica) | *Prices are **bound to** rise.* |
| **be certain / sure to + verbo** | seguridad | *She is **sure to** win.* |
| **be likely / unlikely to + verbo** | probabilidad | *It's **unlikely to** rain.* |
| **be about to + verbo** | inminente (segundos o minutos) | *The film is **about to** start.* |
| **be due to + verbo** | por horario o plan | *The train is **due to** arrive at six.* |
| **be on the point of + -ing** | muy inminente (formal) | *She was **on the point of** leaving.* |
| **may / might well + verbo** | probable pero no seguro | *We **may well** be wrong.* |
| **be expected to** | se espera | *He is **expected to** resign.* |
**Will, going to y presente continuo (repaso)**
- *Will* = predicción/decisión espontánea. · *Going to* = intención o evidencia presente. · *Presente continuo* = arreglo concreto.
- *Look at those clouds! It's going to rain.* (evidencia) · *I'm seeing the doctor at five.* (arreglo)
**Futuro en el pasado**
- *was going to / was about to / was due to* → *I was going to call you, but I forgot.*
- *would* → *He said he would help.*
**Orden de certeza (más a menos)**
*bound to / certain to > likely to > may well > may/might > unlikely to > won't.*
**Errores típicos**
- ✘ *It's bound to will happen.* → ✔ *It's bound to happen.*
- ✘ *The train is about arrive.* → ✔ *The train is about to arrive.*
- ✘ *She's on the point of to leave.* → ✔ *She's on the point of leaving.*
- ✘ *It is probably to rain.* → ✔ *It is likely to rain.* / *It will probably rain.*

**Ojo:** *probably* es adverbio (*It will probably rain*); *likely* es adjetivo (*It is likely to rain*); en inglés norteamericano *likely* puede ser adverbio: *It will likely rain*. *Due to* (previsto) ≠ *due to* (debido a): *The delay was due to the weather.*
Pronunciación: *autonomous* /ɔːˈtɒnəməs/ · *due to* /ˈdjuː tə/ · *bound to* /ˈbaʊnd tə/.
